agents.name: Claude Code

surface_source.quote: Claude Code’s harness has a terrible bug that makes subagents brick the terminal, where new messages say you must compact or clear, but compaction fails.

agents.quote: I would have Claude Code navigate to each comment, print the context before and after, and let me know if it was an easy typo fix or something more nuanced.

also.quote: I put it to work helping make content for my post-training course with Fireworks’ API in Claude Code (setting this up was very easy).

agents.name: Codex
agents.role: second agent, used more evenly since 5.3
agents.quote: For the last few days, I’ve been using both of the models much more evenly.

history.value: Codex with GPT 5.2 xhigh, not yet working for him
history.quote: Codex with GPT 5.2 on xhigh thinking effort alone feels very capable, more meticulous than Claude even, but I haven’t yet figured out how to get the best out of it.
My default workflow now is GPT 5 Pro for planning, Claude Code with Opus 4.5 for implementation.

models.name: GPT 5 Pro
models.quote: I often have Claude Code pass information back to GPT 5 Pro for a deep search when stuck with a very detailed prompt.

review_style.value: Lets agents catch their own mistakes, then checks the results himself
review_style.quote: They make mistakes, they catch most of their own mistakes, and they’re fairly slow too, but they’re capable. I can’t wait to go home and check on what my Claudes were up to.

also.quote: And then I have enough situational awareness to be like, “Okay, these trends obviously make sense,” and you can check things.

harness.value: Claude Code instances left running on a DGX Spark while he is out
harness.quote: I’ve taken to leaving Claude Code instances running on my DGX Spark trying to implement new features in our RL codebase when I’m at dinner or work.

rules_files.value: CLAUDE.md per repo, AGENTS.md symlinked to it for Codex
rules_files.quote: `AGENTS.md` is intentionally a symlink to `CLAUDE.md` for Codex compatibility. If you are Codex and the symlink is present, edit `CLAUDE.md` directly; do not replace, unlink, or edit through `AGENTS.md`.

value: PreToolUse changelog reminder on git commit, git push, gh pr create
hooks.quote:
if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qE 'git commit|git push|gh pr create'; then
  echo "Reminder: Update CHANGELOG.md with ONE line per PR (not per commit) and include the PR link." >&2

signature.caption: Gemini critiques each diagram
signature.why: Our pick: Claude Code draws the textbook figures, then a skill sends each one to Gemini for a second model's review.
signature.quote: For diagram review, use `.claude/skills/gemini-feedback/SKILL.md`; it sends a generated diagram and relevant mathematical context to Gemini for textbook-quality feedback.

archetype.why: Repo skills, a changelog hook and his own agent-native slide tool around Claude Code.

signature_quote.value: Every researcher needs to learn how to run a lab.
signature_quote.more: Agents push the humans up the org chart.
